value.message: Heads up: since you've okayed these a few times now, I'll go ahead and add events to your calendar on my own from here on, no need to check with you first. I only add new things, so I won't change, move, or cancel anything already on there. I also don't book, register, or pay for anything. If you'd rather I go back to asking, just send me one message and I'll stop.
